ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail behind child care fraud in Minnesota, including the flow of federal funds and potential shell companies.
ideas.angle: Financial analysis and shell company investigation
questions: How much federal funding has been allocated to child care in Minnesota?
What shell companies may be involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a larger scheme involving shell companies and embezzlement of federal funds, and I recommend following the money to determine the scope of the issue.
